description: This script initializes and seeds a database with categories, videos, and a demo user for a media streaming platform. It creates database tables, inserts sample data, and sets up a demo directory with placeholder video files.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: Represents a video category such as Action or Comedy.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user in the system with email and password hash.

classes.name: Video
classes.description: Represents a video entity with title, description, file path, and featured status.

methods.name: None ensure_seed()
methods.description: Initializes the database schema and seeds initial data if not already present.

methods.name: None _seed(db: Session)
methods.description: Performs the actual seeding of categories, videos, and user if the database is empty.
